snippets.title: Box's Aaron Levie: On Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion
snippets.takeaway: Enterprise AI is moving from chat rollout toward agentic workflows, with token budgets, rollout speed, and workflow integration becoming the practical bottlenecks.
snippets.summary: Right now, the main focus is let's make the agent really, really good on any model, but over time, obviously, you would peel off certain use cases either on a per customer basis or kind of across the whole dataset. Box is building a collaboration platform and content management platform for the enterprise that has now taken on really new life with AI. They don't want the seller of the token to be the one that is also metering and gating what is the best token for each use case.
